raw_segments.text: I am therefore convinced that the prince who, in presence of an encroaching democracy, should
endeavor to impair the judicial authority in his dominions, and to diminish the political
influence of lawyers, would commit a great mistake.
He would let slip the substance of authority to grasp at the shadow.
He would act more wisely in introducing men connected with the law into the government,
and if he entrusted them with the conduct of a despotic power, bearing some marks of
violence, that power would most likely assume the external features of justice and of legality
